variant-a: A complete desktop website homepage design for 德億茶莊 DEYI TEA HOUSE, a Taiwanese tea house selling its own 杉林溪烏龍茶. Render the web page itself, flat and edge to edge, landscape 16:10 desktop (1440x900 composition). No browser window, no device frame, no desk. STRUCTURE: a deep slate teal #2B4654 page ground. Top-left: the brand's square copper-orange carved seal 德億茶莊 2x2 with the stencil-cut wordmark 'DEYI TEA HOUSE' in cream (reproduce faithfully from the reference image); top-right small cream links 茶品 · 產地 · 製茶 · 泡茶 · 門市 and a small copper button 'LINE 詢價'. THE DOMINANT MOVE: the page IS one very tall vacuum-sealed matte silver foil tea pack seen from the front, as wide as the middle 60% of the page and running off the bottom of the viewport, so scrolling reads down the pack. The pack's white spec label is a long ruled ledger running down the pack, and each ledger row is a section of the site: top row large bold '品名 杉林溪烏龍茶'; row '產地 南投・杉林溪 海拔 1,600m 以上' with a thin contour-line sketch of a ridge; row '製程' listing numbered steps in a horizontal strip 1 採菁 → 2 萎凋 → 3 炒菁 → 4 揉捻 → 5 乾燥, each in a small ruled cell; the strip continues below the fold. Left of the pack on the teal ground a cream headline in a sharp song/ming display face '喝之前，先讀懂這包茶。' with a short paragraph at reading size '產地、製程、焙度，德億把每一包的來歷寫清楚。' and a solid copper button 'LINE 詢價訂購' with '或來電 0X-XXXX-XXXX' beneath. Right of the pack a slim vertical column of small cream caption text and a round copper rubber-stamp mark. Traditional Chinese throughout, crisp, body about 16px relative to 1440px. PALETTE: slate teal, copper, foil silver-grey, label white, ink black. No gradients, no glow, no tea-leaf clip art, no brush calligraphy, no awards or certifications.
